title: Hermosa Beach Self-Guided E-Bike Tour
includes: Use of rear storage bike bag
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The thrill of an electric bike ride will make any day an adventurous one. Start out in Hermosa Beach and experience the feeling of a quality electric bike rental on a fun self-guided tour. Explore the coastline and beyond as you easily ride along the stand, with as little or as much assistance from the bikes pedal assist electric power. We offer a variety of destinations to choose from or feel free to explore and create your own trail. The Marvin Braude Trail will guide you from Hermosa Beach to Santa Monica and back with a variety of sites to see along the way. This e-bike rental comes with the use of a helmet, heavy duty lock, water bottle holder, and rear storage bag. All you need to bring is yourself, book your next adventure today! Rate is for one rider; additional riders can be added at the shop if needed for an additional cost.
